retrievalProfile.description: A magenta-tinted duotone portrait of two musicians in a studio setting, featuring high-contrast lighting and condensed yellow serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic magenta-and-black photograph depicting two men in a recording studio, one playing an acoustic guitar, with bright yellow condensed serif text positioned in the upper center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction through eye contact and shared activity
High-contrast lighting defining facial features and guitar contours
Vibrant yellow typography against a dark magenta background
Tight framing focusing on the upper bodies and instrument
coreInvariants: Condensed serif display typography in yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the mid-ground, filling the frame from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar in the center-right foreground acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the face on the left to the guitar, then to the face on the right, and finally to the text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas in the background provide negative space that emphasizes the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for deep shadows and outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the magenta tones with extreme value contrast between black and light magenta.

letterConstructionRules: Italicized slant for the top line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with variations in slant and size.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Captures the extreme verticality and condensed nature of the primary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, duotone magenta and black photograph of two men in a studio, one playing an acoustic guitar, with dramatic lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add condensed, high-contrast serif text in bright yellow at the top center, using an italicized style for the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly duotone magenta and black?
Is the typography bright yellow and condensed serif?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep black shadows?

mustRedesign: Avoid using actual artist names or logos
Ensure the magenta tint is consistent across the entire image
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duotone photography + condensed serif display type + limited color palette.
